# onlineornot_maintenance_windows (Data Source)

Fetches the list of maintenance windows.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List resources from a project and resources without a project.
data "onlineornot_maintenance_windows" "selected" {
  project_ids = ["a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8", "unassigned"]
}

# Existing single-project filters are also supported.
data "onlineornot_maintenance_windows" "one_project" {
  project_id = "a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Filter by one project ID, or unassigned for resources without a project. Omit both project_id and project_ids to list across all projects. Cannot be combined with project_ids.
- `project_ids` (List of String) Filter by up to 100 project IDs. Include unassigned for resources without a project. Omit both project_id and project_ids to list across all projects. Cannot be combined with project_id.

### Read-Only

- `maintenance_windows` (Attributes List) List of maintenance windows (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--maintenance_windows))

<a id="nestedatt--maintenance_windows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `maintenance_windows`

Read-Only:

- `duration_minutes` (Number) The duration of the maintenance window in minutes
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the maintenance window
- `name` (String) The name of the maintenance window
- `project_id` (String) Owning project ID. Null for unassigned.
- `start_date` (String) The start time of the maintenance window
- `timezone` (String) The timezone for the maintenance window
